decisions.reason: A hearty bread loaf fits the core assortment, costs little to keep in production, and after only one year its demand is still too uncertain to justify abandoning the option.
The historic mill tour builds on existing heritage facilities and event staff, so its holding cost is low, and its experiential value is still unfolding, so the option stays open.
A sweet pastry is a cheap option to hold within the confectionery line, and with only one year of results and no negative signals there is no basis yet for dropping it.
